markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (58%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert

The reliability check flagged the image [F6], and the second model disagrees.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 58%, Normal 26%, InSitu 17%, Invasive 0% | Benign leads, Normal second |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90%) | Cannot separate those two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.52 / 64th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign, 4 Normal | Neighbors favor Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 1, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term here; points away from carcinoma · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scores below typical; no invasive signal · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 3, 6) · ↓ invasive · Elevated; relevant to the 17% InSitu probability · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI (0.47 to 0.60) excludes 0; the heatmap is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; Normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Image quality problems (reliability 0.52) distort the probabilities, including the Benign vs Normal split.
- The second model (MUSK) is right; only 1 of 5 neighbors is Benign.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 3, 6** — check whether duct-confined atypical cells are benign or in situ; InSitu is 17%.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 11** — verify normal lobules with two-layered epithelium; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 0** — inspect stroma for infiltrating tumor and nuclear pleomorphism; both concepts peak here.
